about: The prayer offers sacrificial gifts to God as a pleasing fragrance. It then asks that, instructed by Robert’s counsels and examples, we may run the path of God’s commandments with an open heart.

s01.translation: Lord, we offer You sacrificial gifts as a pleasing fragrance. And grant that, instructed by blessed Robert’s counsels and examples, we may run along the path of Your commandments with our heart opened wide. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

alignments.gloss: instructed by blessed Robert’s counsels and examples
who lives and reigns with You

w008.explanation: “And” joins the offering to the petition that follows. Both Benziger and Vatican print this connective.

w013.explanation: The noun means counsels or admonitions here. It is not the fourth-declension noun monitus and does not require a prophecy sense.

w016.explanation: The implied “we” has been taught by Robert’s counsels and examples and is to run the path. Robert is not the one being taught.

w022.explanation: The heart opened wide is an image of readiness to follow God’s commandments. It describes the manner in which the petitioners ask to run that path.

w040.explanation: “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
